## Referenced Standards

- IEEE 29148-2018 — requirements engineering and traceability
- IEEE 1016-2009 — software design description
- ISO/IEC 42001 — AI management-system concerns
- Thailand PDPA — consent, erasure, retention, and PII-boundary concerns
- Zuri `CLAUDE.md` — repository rulebook and DDD/MSP workflow

## 1. Decision / คำตัดสิน

Zuri SHALL keep its existing V2+V3 documentation pipeline and SHALL NOT introduce a second
monolithic PRD/SDD as another source of truth. The selected structure is **Custom Zuri Hybrid**:

- `gks/phase1_docs/` is canonical for long-lived product requirements and product narratives.
- `docs/specs/CR-*.md` is canonical for active, program-scoped change requests.
- `gks/phase2_atomic/` remains canonical for atomic ADR/MOD/FEAT/PROTO/FLOW knowledge and is
  writable only through the MSP inbound gate.
- `gks/phase3_blueprints/` is canonical for implementation geography and API/data contracts.
- `gks/phase3.5_microtasks/` is canonical for deterministic code-generation decomposition.
- `docs/` remains the human/operator layer for contracts, architecture views, runbooks, reviews,
  evidence, standards, and navigation.
- `docs/.doc-graph.json` is a generated, derived navigation artifact. It never overrides
  `gks/00_index/atomic_index.jsonl` or any canonical document named above.

This is a **canonical split by fact class**, not a claim that one directory owns every fact.

## 2. Authority Matrix / ตารางอำนาจของเอกสาร

| Fact class | Canonical location | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Agent rules and workflow | `CLAUDE.md` | Wins over secondary agent notes |
| Live operational risk flags | root `CRITICAL_FACTS.md` | Old copies must be pointer stubs only |
| Long-lived product requirements | `gks/phase1_docs/` | Reconcile before retiring duplicates |
| Active change requests | `docs/specs/CR-*.md` | Remains canonical unless a later approved decision changes it |
| Atomic decisions and protocols | `gks/phase2_atomic/` | Discover through `atomic_index.jsonl`; write through MSP inbound only |
| Code geography and contracts | `gks/phase3_blueprints/` | Implementation paths must match the approved blueprint |
| Generated implementation tasks | `gks/phase3.5_microtasks/` | AUTO-GENERATED targets follow codegen/compose controls |
| Implemented behavior | Code + tests + runtime evidence | Documentation alone does not prove production readiness |
| Operator procedures | `docs/runbooks/` | Must link to the requirement, CR, or incident that requires the procedure |
| Cross-repo contracts | `docs/contracts/` | Must identify owner, version, approval state, and both consumer repos |

## 3. Traceability Chain / สายการสืบย้อนกลับ

Every new governed change SHOULD be traceable through the applicable links:

```text
Requirement ID
  -> CR or Phase 1 feature narrative
  -> Atomic decision/protocol (when needed)
  -> Phase 3 blueprint
  -> Phase 3.5 task or implementation task
  -> Code and tests
  -> Devlog, review, release, and runtime evidence
```

A missing layer stays explicitly `not-applicable`, `planned`, or `unknown`; it is never inferred
as complete merely because a downstream file exists.

## 4. Requirement IDs / รหัสข้อกำหนด

Existing identifiers (`CR-*`, `FEAT-*`, `ADR-*`, `ZDEV-*`, and unhyphenated `AC1`/`NFR1`) are
preserved. There is no bulk renumbering.

New standalone requirements use the scheme in
`docs/standards/conventions/requirement-id-scheme.md`:

| Prefix | Category |
|---|---|
| `FR-xxx` | Functional requirement |
| `NFR-xxx` | Non-functional requirement |
| `SDD-xxx` | Software design decision |
| `SEC-xxx` | Security requirement |
| `AI-AGT-xxx` | AI agent specification |
| `AI-ETH-xxx` | AI ethics and governance |
| `BR-xxx` | Business rule |
| `AC-xxx` | Acceptance criterion |
| `DR-xxx` | Data requirement |
| `IR-xxx` | Infrastructure requirement |

The counter registry is `docs/.requirement-id-counters.json`. Legacy IDs may be recorded as
aliases in traceability records but SHALL NOT be rewritten solely for formatting consistency.

## 5. Compliance and AI Overlays / ชั้นครอบ Compliance และ AI

Compliance and AI are cross-cutting overlays, not separate competing document trees:

- PDPA and security controls use `SEC-*`, `DR-*`, and linked `AC-*` evidence.
- AI behavior uses `AI-AGT-*`; human oversight, privacy, bias, and disclosure use `AI-ETH-*`.
- Provider/model details belong in an implementation or model/provider card only when they affect
  behavior, risk, cost, data handling, or reproducibility.
- PII boundaries must distinguish cloud operational data, local analytical data, and prohibited
  transfers. A diagram is not sufficient without enforceable contracts and tests.

## 6. Migration Sequence / ลำดับการปรับโครง

1. Register this architecture, the ID scheme, counters, template, and derived graph.
2. Preserve all existing documents and dirty-worktree changes.
3. Execute DOC-RECON content comparison before moving or replacing any duplicate.
4. Keep `docs/specs/CR-*` canonical under this decision; any proposal to move CR authoring into
   `gks/phase1_docs/` requires an explicit versioned amendment to this document and `CLAUDE.md`.
5. Add a drift guard only after its failure and success fixtures are documented and approved.
6. Populate graph edges incrementally; do not bulk-assert relationships that were not verified.

## 7. Acceptance, Success, and Exit Criteria

- **AC-001:** Every artifact created by this scaffold contains a Document Control block or
  machine-readable equivalent.
- **AC-002:** `docs/.doc-graph.json` and `docs/.requirement-id-counters.json` parse as JSON.
- **AC-003:** Every local path represented as a document node in the initial graph exists.
- **AC-004:** No file under `gks/phase2_atomic/` is changed directly.
- **AC-005:** Existing requirement identifiers remain unchanged.
- **Success:** Navigation exposes this architecture and the ID scheme without introducing a new
  PRD/SDD source of truth.
- **Exit:** The scoped diff contains only the approved scaffold and navigation links; unrelated
  working-tree changes remain untouched.

## 8. Out of Scope / นอกขอบเขต

- Moving, deleting, or stubbing the existing `docs/product/` tree
- Editing `gks/phase2_atomic/` directly
- Claiming that DOC-RECON-02 through DOC-RECON-06 are complete
- Retrofitting metadata or new IDs across all existing documents
- Production code, database, deployment, or external-service changes
